parameters.name: BandwidthLimit
parameters.description: The inter-region bandwidth between the two regions. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: BandwidthType
parameters.description:
The bandwidth allocation method. Valid values:

- **BandwidthPackage** (default): Bandwidth is allocated from the bandwidth package.

parameters.name: LocalRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the local region.

You can call [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) to query the regions of the network instances that can be attached to a CEN instance.

parameters.name: OppositeRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the peer region.
